WITH candidates AS (
            (SELECT m.mail_id, m.send_time
             FROM mail m FORCE INDEX (idx_sender_cursor)
             WHERE m.sender_id = 1000000001 AND m.sender_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1
             
        AND ('seed42' = '' OR m.subject LIKE CONCAT('%', 'seed42', '%')
            OR m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', 'seed42', '%'))
    
             
             ORDER BY m.send_time DESC, m.mail_id DESC LIMIT 21)
            UNION ALL
            (SELECT mr.mail_id, mr.mail_send_time AS send_time
             FROM mail_receiver mr FORCE INDEX (idx_receiver_search)
             STRAIGHT_JOIN mail m ON m.mail_id = mr.mail_id
             WHERE mr.receiver_id = 1000000001 AND mr.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1
               AND NOT (m.sender_id = 1000000001 AND m.sender_deleted = FALSE)
             
        AND ('seed42' = '' OR m.subject LIKE CONCAT('%', 'seed42', '%')
            OR m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', 'seed42', '%'))
    
             
               AND mr.id = (SELECT MIN(r.id) FROM mail_receiver r
                            WHERE r.mail_id = mr.mail_id AND r.receiver_id = 1000000001 AND r.is_deleted = FALSE)
             ORDER BY mr.mail_send_time DESC, mr.mail_id DESC LIMIT 21)
        )
        SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mail_star ms WHERE ms.user_id = 1000000001 AND ms.mail_id = m.mail_id) is_starred,
               m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username sender_name, u.email sender_email,
               m.subject, LEFT(m.content, 50) content, m.send_time, m.has_attachment,
               m.is_spam, m.priority, m.mail_status, m.sender_deleted
        FROM candidates c JOIN mail m ON m.mail_id = c.mail_id
        JOIN user u ON u.user_id = m.sender_id
        ORDER BY c.send_time DESC, c.mail_id DESC LIMIT 21
